category_description: Federal income tax, payroll tax and other taxes in the United States.
subcategory_description: The taxes taken from pay and from self-employment income.
label: Self-employment tax rate for Social Security
context: Applies to net earnings from self-employment up to the Social Security wage base.

label: Self-employment tax rate for Medicare
context: Applies to all net earnings from self-employment. The Additional Medicare Tax can apply above a threshold.

label: Share of net earnings subject to self-employment tax
context: Generally the amount subject to self-employment tax is this share of your net earnings from self-employment.

label: Net earnings that trigger self-employment tax
context: You usually must pay self-employment tax if you had net earnings from self-employment of this much or more.

subject_intro: Who pays self-employment tax, the two parts of the rate, how much income it applies to, and the deduction for half of the tax.
